title: A finite etale-covered scheme over a dense open, refined by an etale cover

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Integral refined scheme over a dense open
standard_prerequisites.use: pi : Y -> X integral with Y a scheme, finite etale over a qcqs dense open U.

standard_prerequisites.name: Integral limits of finite presentation refinements
standard_prerequisites.use: Y = lim Y_i with pi_i finite fp over X and pi^{-1}(U) -> pi_i^{-1}(U) an isomorphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Limits that are schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: Y_i is a scheme for i large.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Affine opens W_{i,j} recovering W_j in the inverse image.

standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of locally finite presentation spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the factorizations W_j -> V to W_{i,j} -> U for i large.

core_obligations: (2) 构造：decent-spaces 引理给 π:Y→X（Y 概形、积分）与拟紧稠密开 U 使 π^{-1}U→U finite etale；取有限仿射覆盖 Y=∪W_j 使 W_j→X 过 V；lemma-integral-limit-finite-and-finite-presentation-refined 写 Y=lim Y_i（π_i finite fp、π^{-1}U→π_i^{-1}U 同构）；lemma-limit-is-scheme 给大 i 使 Y_i 是概形；lemma-descend-opens 给仿射开 W_{i,j}⊂Y_i 其 Y 中原像恢复 W_j；proposition-characterize 再增 i 使 W_j→V 过 X 的态射来自 W_{i,j}→U 的态射（~3929-3945 行）。
difficulty_reason: 积分逼近 + 下降开 + 极限保持提升全程展示、每步具名锚定；无省略。
